title: Q-SYNC-DRIFT-practical-solutions: tenant practical-solutions is 8.5 days behind the platform (13 files, status needs-pr)
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** tenant-sync --run
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation tenantsync --probe drift:practical-solutions
**Prediction:** tenant_sync_drift_days <= 2 within 48 h
**Status:** closed

Read the last rows for practical-solutions in ops/tenant-sync/ledger.jsonl, fix what stops the re-vendor pull request (token, clone, tool error), and land it through the tenant's lane.

**Closing probe:** cmd:python3 -m foundation tenantsync --probe drift:practical-solutions

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-26T07:32:32Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 14.8 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
